Name: Pretty Anime Genderbends
Author: SerDakota
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]The portraits were generated using Novel Ai.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]A add on mod to my Pretty Anime Portraits mod, but also functions as standalone to change any male character with portraits to a female. It originally was a part of Pretty Anime Portraits but has grown into a size I feel it warrants its own page. You can see a detailed list of who has been changed below as well. It does NOT currently change any NPC names or dialogue. That is being worked on and will release when it releases.[/color]

[b]STOP ASKING ABOUT SVE! ITS REALLY ANNOYING AND I DONT HAVE PERMISSION!! IF I HAD PERMISSION IT WOULD OF BEEN RELEASED ALREADY. SAME GOES FOR RIDGESIDE![/b]

I appreciate y'all wanting them and I wish I could do it but as it stands I cant. Not without a way to replace the sprites which I dont currently have the money for and even if I did its not a certainty it wouldnt get removed anyways. If someone wants to donate and gamble their money info on the Discord.

On my Discord I don't mind helping you to make your own portraits for them for your own personal use but that's about all I can do publicly.

[color=#d4d4d8]For the sprites some has sprites custom commissioned (thanks to generous donations) to match my portraits. Others the portrait have been designed to somewhat match the sprite. The rest my Discord voted they would rather have ANY female sprite over a male one so they do not match at all besides just being female. I would love to one day have full custom matching sprites but unless some Saudi Prince decides to give me a ton of money that likely wont happen lol. Still any donates I get for the foreseeable future will go back into getting sprites made.[/color]

IF YOU WANT CHANGED DIALOGUE: Than download both the required mod and the optional file.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Pretty Anime Portraits is Optional if you would like a consistent style with the rest of the characters. (Highly Recommended)
Shop Portrait Overhaul Framework is required for the shop portraits.
GMGM is optional if youd like to be able to turn on or off certain characters plus change their shop portrait.
DDFC Scaler if youd like more control over the size and placement of the portraits and dialogue window.
